paper.title_en: Probing quantum chaos near a wormhole throat with a circular string
paper.abstract_en: We investigate whether quantum fluctuations of a circular probe string develop a quantum-chaotic response while traversing a wormhole throat. The classical circular-string embedding is periodic and radially stable, but its two physical transverse polarizations experience time-dependent tidal potentials. Expanding the world-sheet action to quadratic order, we canonically quantize these modes and construct out-of-time-ordered correlator(OTOC) amplitudes from their unequal-time commutators. For the Ellis--Bronnikov wormhole, both polarizations exhibit finite intervals of approximately exponential OTOC growth associated with the first throat passage. The corresponding dimensionless rate measured with respect to physical time is positive over the parameter range studied and generally decreases as the probe energy is increased relative to the throat scale. In the global-monopole extension, increasing the solid-angle deficit narrows the band of locally amplifiable modes and suppresses the extracted rates; a sufficiently strong defect can nearly quench the radial signal, while the angular channel retains a polarization-dependent non-monotonic structure when the energy-to-throat-scale ratio is small. These quantities characterize finite-time dynamical sensitivity in the Gaussian fluctuation sector and should not be identified with asymptotic many-body chaos or a thermodynamic phase transition. Although the numerical analysis uses two representative wormhole geometries, the construction depends only on covariant world-sheet fluctuations and real-time commutators. It therefore provides a transferable, non-holographic framework for applying quantum-chaos diagnostics directly to quantum probes in curved spacetimes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在弯曲时空量子场论框架内研究圆环探针弦在虫洞喉附近的量子混沌响应，采用世界面二次展开、正则量子化与不等时对易子构造的OTOC作为诊断量，并把结论严格限定在高斯涨落扇区的有限时间动力学敏感性，未夸大为渐近多体混沌或热力学相变。方法构建只依赖协变世界面涨落与实时对易子，因而具有可迁移性，属于弯曲时空基础问题（量子混沌诊断、探针动力学）而非黑洞热力学核心，故主类定为广义相对论基础，次级涉及黑洞热力学与全息凝聚态。理论深度、方法透明度与表述清晰度均较突出，故建议进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 用圆环弦探测虫洞喉附近的量子混沌
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个圆环探针弦的量子涨落，在穿越虫洞喉时是否会产生量子混沌响应。经典的圆环弦嵌入是周期的且径向稳定的，但其两个物理横向极化会经历含时潮汐势。将世界面作用量展开到二次阶，我们对这些模进行正则量子化，并由其不等时对易子构造出时序外关联函数（OTOC）振幅。对于Ellis--Bronnikov虫洞，两种极化都表现出与第一次穿越喉相关的、近似指数式OTOC生长的有限区间。以物理时间测量的相应无量纲速率在所研究的参数范围内为正，并且当探针能量相对于喉尺度增大时，该速率通常减小。在整体单极子推广中，增大立体角亏损会缩窄局域可放大模的频带，并压低所提取的速率；足够强的缺陷几乎可以淬灭径向信号，而当能量与喉尺度之比很小时，角向通道保留一种依赖于极化的非单调结构。这些量刻画的是高斯涨落扇区中的有限时间动力学敏感性，不应将其等同于渐近多体混沌或热力学相变。尽管数值分析使用了两个代表性的虫洞几何，该构造只依赖于协变的世界面涨落和实时对易子。因此，它提供了一个可迁移的、非全息框架，用于将量子混沌诊断直接应用于弯曲时空中的量子探针。
